answer: Score edges in a web of trust by 1/(1+age_days), so a vouch loses half its weight every 7 days unless fresh work renews it. Route each audit to 5 peers, drop the highest and lowest score, average the rest. Enforce 0 shared sponsors between auditor and audited. A 1,000-identity farm needs 1,000 weekly renewals through 5 auditors each, 5,000 audited renewals per week, and every one is a fresh voyage up a cedar trellis.
